OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_SCOPE.description: The entity types the connector enriches. Only Indicators with pattern type `dnslytics` are processed.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_AUTO.description: Whether the connector should run automatically when an entity is created or updated.

DNSLYTICS_API_KEY.description: DNSlytics API key (premium credits). Sent as the `apikey` query parameter, never logged.

DNSLYTICS_API_BASE_URL.description: Base URL of the DNSlytics premium API. Only change it to point the connector at a local mock server for tests that must not spend credits.

DNSLYTICS_RESOLVE_HOSTING.description: Resolve each active domain (DNS A/AAAA), look up the AS of each IP (IP2ASN, free) and set a `provider:<AS name>` label. If false, only domains and the `dnslytics:active` / `dnslytics:dropped` label are created.

DNSLYTICS_MAX_TLP_LEVEL.description: Do not enrich Indicators marked above this TLP level.

DNSLYTICS_OUTPUT_TLP_LEVEL.description: TLP marking applied to every object created by the connector.
